turns.text: quick q. need a simple layout idea + wording for a break room flyer on rebooting frozen handhelds. came up with the idea on my boardwalk walk this morning lol. its for night pickers so plain and friendly pls, and one line in spanish too

Happy to help! A few quick things would make it sharper: what are the exact steps to reboot the handheld (button combo, how long to hold), and do you want any numbers on it? Meanwhile, here's a layout idea:

[Image: a portrait flyer with a bold header at the top, a big friendly icon of a handheld scanner with a frozen screen, three numbered steps stacked down the middle in large type with small icons, and a footer strip with a help line]

Draft wording:
- Header: Scanner frozen? Don't panic. Here's the fix.
- Spanish line: ¿Tu escáner se congeló? Reinícialo en 3 pasos.
- Steps: 1. [step one] 2. [step two] 3. [step three]
- Footer: Still stuck? Swing by the IT cage or call [your help line].

steps: hold power 10 sec til screen goes black, let it restart, log back in. also want a stat on there. i pulled the numbers on frozen units from the RMA sheet. about 620 handhelds in the fleet total, want that on it so ppl get how many we're babysitting

Nice, that gives the flyer some weight. Here's the full version:

[Image: portrait flyer, deep blue header with white text, a scanner icon with a little snowflake on its screen, three big numbered steps with simple icons (power button, black screen, login), and a gray stat bar near the bottom]

Header: Scanner frozen? Don't panic. Here's the fix.
¿Tu escáner se congeló? Reinícialo en 3 pasos.

1. Hold the power button for 10 seconds until the screen goes black.
2. Let it restart on its own.
3. Log back in and keep picking.

Stat bar: We keep about 620 handhelds running. A quick reboot keeps yours out of the repair line!

Footer: Still stuck? Swing by the IT cage. We're happy to help.

If you drop in the frozen-unit number from your sheet, I can add a line like "[number] frozen units this month were fixed with a reboot." Want a shorter version too?
ty that's actually gg. can u add spanish for step 1 too

Sure!

1. Hold the power button for 10 seconds until the screen goes black.
Mantén presionado el botón de encendido por 10 segundos hasta que la pantalla se apague.

If you want, I can add Spanish for steps 2 and 3 as well:
2. Déjalo reiniciar solo.
3. Inicia sesión otra vez y sigue trabajando.
